title: Integrations
subtitle: Connect the tools that send leads in and take updates out. A connector shows Connected only when it holds credentials and {platform} has switched it live.

blocked.not_available: Switched off for this environment by {platform}.
blocked.needs_vendor_approval: Waiting for the vendor to approve {platform}. It will be enabled when approved.
blocked.needs_client_credentials: Needs account access from your side before it can be switched on.
blocked.not_configured: {platform} has not set up this vendor app yet.
blocked.support: Not available in a support session.
blocked.permission: Only the workspace Owner can change integrations. Your role: {role}.
blocked.demo: Demo workspace: nothing is saved and no vendor is called.
emptyBody: The connector catalogue is empty for this environment. Ask {platform} support to check the platform console.
errorBody: The catalogue could not be read. Your connections are unchanged.
deniedBody: Integrations are visible to the Owner and the roles the Owner grants. Your role: {role}.
sandboxBanner: Sandbox: not sending to real customers. Data on this page is test data.
auth.oauth2: OAuth: you approve on the vendor site
auth.api_key: API key stored in the encrypted vault
auth.service_account: Service account key stored in the encrypted vault
mock.sandbox: Use the test key shown in the runbook. Nothing leaves this system.
meta-ads.sandbox: Use a Meta test ad account and the Lead Ads Testing Tool. Test leads and sample spend only; nothing reaches real customers.
zoho-crm.sandbox: Use a Zoho CRM developer or sandbox org. Records written and read there stay in that org; the CRM only syncs what the field map and sync options allow.
hubspot.sandbox: Use a HubSpot developer test account (a free test portal with sample data). Nothing reaches a real customer portal.
razorpay.sandbox: Use Razorpay test keys (rzp_test_...) and its published test cards. No real money moves.
whatsapp.sandbox: Use Meta's test business number and up to 5 test recipients. Nothing reaches real customers.
ga4.sandbox: Showcase only: sample sessions and key events, nothing is read from Google. A live connection reads your own GA4 property with read-only access.
google-ads.sandbox: Use a Google Ads test account with the developer token in test mode. Showcase shows sample spend only; nothing is read from Google.
google-sheets.sandbox: Showcase reads one fictional sample sheet. Imported sample rows are flagged as sample data.
disconnectBody: The stored credentials are deleted from the vault and syncing stops. Records already imported stay. You can connect again later.
testFailMsg: The vendor rejected the saved credentials
testFailSub: The connection now needs attention. Reconnect it to resume syncing.
syncQueuedSub: It starts within a minute. Results appear in the sync log.
oauthDenied: The vendor did not approve the connection.
oauthFailed: The connection could not be completed. Try again.
oauthExpired: The sign-in took too long. Start again.
oauthState: The sign-in response did not match. Start again.
err.not_available: This connector is switched off for this environment.
err.not_configured: {platform} has not set up this vendor app yet.
err.needs_client_credentials: Needs account access from your side.
err.vault_failed: The credentials could not be stored. Nothing was saved.
err.audit_failed: The change could not be recorded in the audit log, so it was not applied.
err.wrong_auth: This connector signs in with OAuth. Use the Authorise button.
logEmptyBody: Runs appear here after the first sync.
metaHealth.label: Connection health
metaHealth.webhookNo: Webhooks subscribed: NO, instant leads and messages are off
metaHealth.retryStill: Meta still refused the subscription. Check the app permissions, then reconnect.
stepsOwnerNote: In order. Steps that need the vendor admin are marked.
mapNone: No field map yet. It is created when the connector ships.
mapIntro: Their field on the left, our column on the right. Your edits replace the default for that field.
mapPreviewInvalid: The sample is not valid JSON.
map.external_required: Their object and field are required.
map.column_invalid: The column name is not valid.
map.stage_map_required: Add a stage map as JSON.
csvNote: CSV import is available from the Import button on Leads.
blocked.not_shipped: This connector is not built yet.
email.sandbox: Use the sandbox key shown in the runbook. Nothing leaves this system and nothing is delivered.
mailchimp.sandbox: Mailchimp has no sandbox. Connect a test audience in your own Mailchimp account.
linkedin.sandbox: LinkedIn has no public sandbox. Showcase shows sample leads and spend only; a live connection needs LinkedIn's approval of the Advertising API and Lead Sync products.
google-business.sandbox: Showcase only: sample reviews and daily performance, nothing is read from or sent to Google. Google grants the Business Profile APIs to approved applications only, so a live connection needs that approval first.
slack.sandbox: Showcase uses sample channels only; nothing is posted to a real Slack workspace. A live connection posts to the channel you pick.
zapier.sandbox: Zapier has no sandbox. Use a test Zap with a sandbox API key; nothing reaches real customers unless a Zap sends it.
make.sandbox: Make has no sandbox. Use a test scenario with a sandbox API key; nothing reaches real customers unless a scenario sends it.
google-calendar.sandbox: Showcase uses a sample calendar with two sample events; nothing is read from or written to Google.
gmail.sandbox: Showcase reads no mail and sends nothing. A live connection needs the platform's Google app in testing mode and your opt-in.
outlook.sandbox: Showcase only: sample mail and calendar events, nothing is read from or sent to Microsoft. A live connection needs the app's publisher verification at Microsoft first; a tenant admin can pre-approve it for the whole firm with the admin-consent link.
meta-ads.name: Instagram and Facebook
meta-ads.blurb: See your Instagram and Facebook Page followers, posts and reach, capture Lead Ads leads and receive Instagram messages in the CRM. The same connection powers Meta ad reporting.
meta.listNeed.connect: Not connected yet. Start with Connect Facebook.
meta.listNeed.reconnect: Access needs renewing. Reconnect to resume syncing.
meta.listNeed.connected: Connected. Open it to see the Page, Instagram account and sync state.
metaSteps.title: Connect Instagram and Facebook
metaSteps.sub: Four steps. Each one shows whether it is done.
metaSteps.next.connect: Click Connect Facebook and approve every permission Meta asks for.
metaSteps.next.reconnect: Reconnect Facebook: Meta access has lapsed or permissions are missing.
metaSteps.next.renew: Reconnect soon: Meta access expires in {days} days.
metaSteps.next.scopes: Reconnect and approve the missing permissions: {list}.
metaSteps.next.choose: Choose the Facebook Page (and its Instagram account) to track.
metaSteps.next.sync: Wait for the first sync (within 3 hours) or use Run sync now below.
metaSteps.next.webhooks: Syncing works. Instant leads and messages need the platform webhook setup, which is still pending.
metaSteps.next.done: All set. Data refreshes every 3 hours.
metaSteps.next.blocked: Connecting is not available for you right now: {reason}
metaSteps.s1.title: Connect Facebook
metaSteps.s1.todo: Sign in with the Facebook account that manages your Page. Instagram uses the same sign-in.
metaSteps.s1.attention: Meta access has lapsed or is incomplete. Reconnect to continue.
metaSteps.s1.expiryUnknown: Expiry date not recorded yet (checked daily)
metaSteps.s2.title: Choose Page and Instagram account
metaSteps.s2.todo: Pick the Facebook Page to track. Its linked Instagram account comes with it.
metaSteps.s2.done: Tracking this Page and Instagram account.
metaSteps.s2.noIg: Instagram: no account linked to this Page
metaSteps.s2.oneOnly: One Page per workspace for now. Choosing another Page replaces this one. Support for several accounts is planned.
metaSteps.s3.title: Webhooks (instant leads and messages)
metaSteps.s3.pending: Pending platform setup. The webhook URL and verify token will be shown here once {platform} enables the platform webhook endpoint.
metaSteps.s3.notSubscribed: Page subscription: Meta refused it. Use Retry webhook subscription above.
metaSteps.s3.fallback: Until then data arrives by polling every 3 hours.
metaSteps.s4.title: First sync
metaSteps.s4.waiting: No successful sync yet. It starts within a few minutes of choosing the Page, then every 3 hours.
metaFlow.insights: Daily ad spend, clicks and reach
metaFlow.social: Instagram and Facebook followers, posts and reach
